min_standing_note: Bachelor-level courses are open to 2nd- and 3rd-year students (typically >=30 ECTS in field); Master-level courses are reserved for Master's students (>=60 ECTS in field; Law Master's >=100 ECTS).
excluded_majors: ["Dentistry (faculty-level agreement required; Danish only)","Medicine (limited clinical capacity; specific bilateral placement required)"]
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020: Expected English proficiency comparable to TOEFL iBT 83 or IELTS 6.5 (no RHET 1020 exemption stated). Documentation varies by faculty: Aarhus BSS (none required); Health (none required); Arts (required for English degree programme only); Natural Sciences and Technical Sciences (documentation may be required).
host_language_requirement: None required for English-taught exchange courses (Danish required only for Danish-taught courses such as Dentistry; optional Danish language courses offered).
fall_term_dates: Autumn semester (AY 2026-2027): Mandatory AU Intro Days late-August/early-September; Courses late-August to late-January; Exam period mid-December to late-January (exact dates vary by study programme).
spring_term_dates: Spring semester (AY 2026-2027): Mandatory AU Intro Days late-January/early-February; Courses late-January to late-June; Exam period mid-May to late-June (exact dates vary by study programme).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance: No mandatory host tuition or student union fee stated for exchange students. Stays >3 months are covered by Danish Health Insurance once issued a CPR number; stays <3 months require private health insurance. Students must arrange private travel, personal belongings, accident, and third-party liability insurance.
housing_notes: Optional AU Housing application is integrated into the admission application (deadlines Apr 1 Autumn / Oct 1 Spring). No housing guarantee; offers sent by Jul 1 (Autumn) and Dec 15 (Spring) with a 48-hour acceptance window requiring credit/debit card payment of 600 DKK non-refundable booking fee + first month's rent (deposit of 1-3 months' rent billed with 2nd month's rent). Estimated AU Housing rent 350-600 EUR/mo (~3,000-4,000 DKK/mo); AU advises applying to Student Housing Aarhus (Ungdomsbolig Aarhus) as backup.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof: Non-EU/EEA students staying >3 months require a Danish student residence permit via SIRI. Normal processing takes up to 2 months (~60 days; up to 3 months if additional documentation is needed). Financial proof required: monthly funds matching the Danish SU grant benchmark (DKK 7,086/month at 2025 level, covering the full stay) in the student's own bank account.
credit_system_and_load: ECTS; full-time study workload is 30 ECTS per semester (Danish grading scale: 12, 10, 7, 4, 02 passing; 00, -03 fail; some pass/fail exams).
course_restrictions_note: Students must select courses from 1 faculty only (and most faculties allow 1 department only, per Brev.pdf#page=3). Law offers no Bachelor-level English courses (Master-level Law requires >=100 ECTS); Dentistry is Danish-only via faculty agreements; Medicine international semester has limited clinical capacity and requires Bachelor/3 years Medicine, C1 English, and clinical experience.
required_application_docs: ["Online application via AU portal (post-nomination)","Official university transcript of records (PDF in English)","Bachelor's degree diploma & transcript (if already earned and applying for Master-level courses)","Documentation of English language skills (faculty/department-dependent; not required for Aarhus BSS or Health)","Passport number (entered in the online application form)"]
academic_style: Informal classroom culture with flat hierarchy (first-name basis with faculty), open critical discussion, and independent study; some courses enforce mandatory attendance for exam eligibility.
international_support_services: Mandatory AU Intro Days (orientation before semester start with CPR/residence guidance, campus tours, social events), mentor/buddy contact via email where applicable, AU International Student Guide app, and Danish language courses.
nomination_deadlines: Autumn semester (AY 2026-2027): Nomination 15 Feb - 25 Mar, Application 1 Mar - 1 Apr. Spring semester (AY 2026-2027): Nomination 15 Aug - 25 Sep, Application 1 Sep - 1 Oct (housing application deadline is the same).

nomination_deadlines: Fall Semester & Academic Year: nomination March 1, application April 1. Spring Semester: nomination September 1, application October 1.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof: J-1 Visa (Form DS-2019) requires proof of funding equating the billable Cost of Attendance under myStudyAbroad Costs tab (Certificate of Finances; $12,933/sem or $25,866/AY in 2024-25 baseline).
credit_system_and_load: US semester credit hours (1 cr = 15 in-class hrs; most courses 3 cr). Limit: 12 credits min (immigration floor) to 18 credits max; 15 credits recommended (>18 cr billed extra per credit).
course_restrictions_note: Restricted to WSU Pullman campus (100-400 undergraduate levels; 500+ graduate courses and non-Pullman campuses excluded); prerequisites enforced and preferred courses cannot be guaranteed.
